041651: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_initializer_bytes(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 start, u32 end, IrTypeId root_type, u8* bytes, u64 byte_count,

041654: // The scalar leaves of an aggregate initializer, classified before they are
041655: // folded.  Almost every leaf of a large table is one number -- the generated
041656: // instruction metadata is arrays of small integer records -- and the general
041657: // folder (c_ir_constant_initializer_bytes_legacy) prices each at a task
041658: // array, a compound-literal probe, a query frame, the shunting-yard
041659: // evaluator, a cast and a byte loop.  A leaf whose tokens are exactly a
041660: // number, a signed number, a character constant or an identifier naming an
041661: // integer constant, landing in an integer, boolean, enum or float member
041662: // that is not a bit-field, is folded here
041663: // instead: the same literal routines and typing rules the evaluator uses
041664: // (c_ir_integer_literal_type, c_ir_float_literal_value,
041665: // c_ir_decode_character_value), the evaluator's unary `+`/`-`
041666: // (c_ir_constant_apply_unary) and its cast (c_ir_constant_cast), then one
041667: // little-endian store of the member's size.  The class is one byte decided
041668: // from the token kinds and the member's kind alone; an arm that cannot
041669: // reproduce the evaluator's answer -- a literal no type holds, a 128-bit
041670: // operand, an imaginary suffix -- declines, and the leaf takes the general
041671: // folder, so every refusal and its message stay exactly what they were.
041672: // A big-endian target keeps the byte loop: only the little-endian store is
041673: // written here.
041674: typedef enum CIrInitializerLeafClass
041675: {
041676:     C_IR_INITIALIZER_LEAF_OTHER,
041677:     C_IR_INITIALIZER_LEAF_INTEGER_TO_INTEGER,
041678:     C_IR_INITIALIZER_LEAF_INTEGER_TO_FLOAT,
041679:     C_IR_INITIALIZER_LEAF_FLOAT_TO_FLOAT,
041680:     C_IR_INITIALIZER_LEAF_CHARACTER_TO_INTEGER,
041681:     C_IR_INITIALIZER_LEAF_IDENTIFIER_TO_INTEGER,
041682: } CIrInitializerLeafClass;
041683: 
041684: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_identifier(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 token_index, CIrConstantValue* result);
041685: 
041686: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL u8 c_ir_constant_initializer_leaf_class(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrType* child, u32 start, u32 end)
041687: {
041688:     u8 leaf_class = C_IR_INITIALIZER_LEAF_OTHER;
041689:     CToken* tokens = builder->preprocess.tokens;
041690:     u32 count = end - start;
041691:     bool signed_prefix =
041692:         count == 2 && (c_token_is_punctuator(&tokens[start], C_PUNCTUATOR_PLUS) || c_token_is_punctuator(&tokens[start], C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS));
041693:     if ((count == 1 || signed_prefix) && builder->program->data_layout.endianness == TARGET_ENDIAN_LITTLE)
041694:     {
041695:         CToken literal = tokens[end - 1];
041696:         u64 size = child->layout.size;
041697:         // The sizes one u64 of bits fills: a wider member takes the general
041698:         // evaluator and the two-limb byte writer.
041699:         bool integer_child = (child->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER || child->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN || child->kind == IR_TYPE_ENUM) &&
041700:                              (size == 1 || size == 2 || size == 4 || size == 8);
041701:         // binary16, f32 and f64: the x87 element has its own folder ahead of
041702:         // the general one, and any other width is stored through the general
041703:         // folder's own conversion.
041704:         bool float_child = child->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT && ((child->bit_width == 16 && size == 2) || (child->bit_width == 32 && size == 4) ||
041705:                                                             (child->bit_width == 64 && size == 8));
041706:         if (literal.kind == C_TOKEN_PREPROCESSING_NUMBER)
041707:         {
041708:             bool floating = c_number_is_float(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, literal));
041709:             if (integer_child && !floating)
041710:             {
041711:                 leaf_class = C_IR_INITIALIZER_LEAF_INTEGER_TO_INTEGER;
041712:             }
041713:             else if (float_child)
041714:             {
041715:                 leaf_class = floating ? C_IR_INITIALIZER_LEAF_FLOAT_TO_FLOAT : C_IR_INITIALIZER_LEAF_INTEGER_TO_FLOAT;
041716:             }
041717:         }
041718:         else if (literal.kind == C_TOKEN_CHARACTER_LITERAL && integer_child)
041719:         {
041720:             leaf_class = C_IR_INITIALIZER_LEAF_CHARACTER_TO_INTEGER;
041721:         }
041722:         else if (literal.kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER && integer_child)
041723:         {
041724:             leaf_class = C_IR_INITIALIZER_LEAF_IDENTIFIER_TO_INTEGER;
041725:         }
041726:     }
041727:     return leaf_class;
041728: }
041729: 
041730: // `size` bytes of `bits`, least significant first: what
041731: // c_ir_constant_store_unit_bits writes for a little-endian target and a
041732: // member no wider than the bits.  Spelled per size so the stores merge.
041733: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_constant_store_little_endian(u8* bytes, u64 size, u64 bits)
041734: {
041735:     switch (size)
041736:     {
041737:     case 1:
041738:         bytes[0] = (u8)bits;
041739:         break;
041740:     case 2:
041741:         bytes[0] = (u8)bits;
041742:         bytes[1] = (u8)(bits >> 8);
041743:         break;
041744:     case 4:
041745:         bytes[0] = (u8)bits;
041746:         bytes[1] = (u8)(bits >> 8);
041747:         bytes[2] = (u8)(bits >> 16);
041748:         bytes[3] = (u8)(bits >> 24);
041749:         break;
041750:     case 8:
041751:         bytes[0] = (u8)bits;
041752:         bytes[1] = (u8)(bits >> 8);
041753:         bytes[2] = (u8)(bits >> 16);
041754:         bytes[3] = (u8)(bits >> 24);
041755:         bytes[4] = (u8)(bits >> 32);
041756:         bytes[5] = (u8)(bits >> 40);
041757:         bytes[6] = (u8)(bits >> 48);
041758:         bytes[7] = (u8)(bits >> 56);
041759:         break;
041760:     default:
041761:         BUSTER_TODO();
041762:     }
041763: }
041764: 
041765: // The evaluator's unary `+`/`-` on an integer constant of `*type`
041766: // (c_ir_constant_apply_unary): a boolean or narrow operand is promoted to
041767: // int first -- no literal type is that narrow, but the rule is kept so the
041768: // arm and the evaluator cannot disagree -- and the result is masked to the
041769: // operand's width.  False for the 128-bit operand, whose wide negate stays
041770: // with the evaluator.
041771: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_initializer_leaf_unary(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrType** type, u64* integer, bool negative)
041772: {
041773:     IrType* operand = *type;
041774:     if (operand->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN || (operand->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER && operand->bit_width < 32))
041775:     {
041776:         operand = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, builder->s32_type);
041777:     }
041778:     bool applied = operand && !(operand->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER && operand->bit_width == 128);
041779:     if (applied)
041780:     {
041781:         u64 value = negative ? 0 - *integer : *integer;
041782:         *integer = value & c_ir_integer_type_mask(operand);
041783:         *type = operand;
041784:     }
041785:     return applied;
041786: }
041787: 
041788: // An integer constant of `literal_type` stored into the integer member
041789: // `child`: c_ir_constant_cast replays a signed source's sign bit before the
041790: // target mask. A boolean tests nonzero before that narrowing.
041791: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_constant_initializer_store_integer_leaf(IrType* child, IrType* literal_type, u64 integer, u8* bytes)
041792: {
041793:     u64 value = literal_type->is_signed ? (u64)c_ir_integer_signed_value(integer, literal_type) : integer;
041794:     u64 converted = child->kind == IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN ? value != 0 : value & c_ir_integer_type_mask(child);
041795:     c_ir_constant_store_little_endian(bytes, child->layout.size, converted);
041796: }
041797: 
041798: // A floating value stored into the binary16, f32 or f64 member `child`: the
041799: // cast rounds at the member's own precision (c_ir_constant_cast), and the
041800: // folder writes that value's bits.
041801: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_constant_initializer_store_float_leaf(IrType* child, f64 floating, u8* bytes)
041802: {
041803:     u64 bits = 0;
041804:     if (child->bit_width == 16)
041805:     {
041806:         bits = child->float_format == IR_FLOAT_FORMAT_BFLOAT16 ? c_ir_bfloat16_bits_from_f64(floating) : c_ir_float16_bits_from_f64(floating);
041807:     }
041808:     else if (child->bit_width == 32)
041809:     {
041810:         f32 narrowed = (f32)(f64)(f32)floating;
041811:         u32 narrowed_bits = 0;
041812:         memcpy(&narrowed_bits, &narrowed, sizeof(narrowed_bits));
041813:         bits = narrowed_bits;
041814:     }
041815:     else
041816:     {
041817:         memcpy(&bits, &floating, sizeof(bits));
041818:     }
041819:     c_ir_constant_store_little_endian(bytes, child->layout.size, bits);
041820: }

041822: // The INTEGER_TO_INTEGER and INTEGER_TO_FLOAT arms: an integer literal,
041823: // typed by c_ir_integer_literal_type exactly as the evaluator types it.
041824: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_initializer_fold_integer_leaf(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u8 leaf_class, IrType* child, u32 start, u32 end,
041825:                                                                     u8* bytes)
041826: {
041827:     CToken* tokens = builder->preprocess.tokens;
041828:     bool signed_prefix = end - start == 2;
041829:     bool negative = signed_prefix && c_token_is_punctuator(&tokens[start], C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS);
041830:     String8 spelling = c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, tokens[end - 1]);
041831:     u64 integer = 0;
041832:     bool folded = c_conditional_number(spelling, &integer);
041833:     IrType* literal_type = folded ? ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, c_ir_integer_literal_type(builder, spelling, integer)) : 0;
041834:     folded = literal_type != 0;
041835:     if (folded && signed_prefix)
041836:     {
041837:         folded = c_ir_constant_initializer_leaf_unary(builder, &literal_type, &integer, negative);
041838:     }
041839:     if (folded)
041840:     {
041841:         if (leaf_class == C_IR_INITIALIZER_LEAF_INTEGER_TO_INTEGER)
041842:         {
041843:             c_ir_constant_initializer_store_integer_leaf(child, literal_type, integer, bytes);
041844:         }
